name: New York City Leading Causes of Death
description:
This dataset contains records of the leading causes of death in New York City from 2007 to 2021. Each row reports a death count and death rates for a combination of year, leading cause of death, sex, and race/ethnicity group. There are 42 distinct causes (such as heart disease, influenza and pneumonia, chronic liver disease, and mental and behavioral disorders), four sex categories (with both abbreviated and full labels like F/Female and M/Male), and eight race/ethnicity groups, including Hispanic, Black Non-Hispanic, Asian and Pacific Islander, and "Not Stated/Unknown." The deaths column holds counts, while death_rate and age_adjusted_death_rate give crude and age-adjusted rates per 100,000 population; both rate columns are missing for about 16% of rows, and the numeric fields are stored as text.

The data can be used to track how the ranking and burden of leading causes of death changed over time, compare mortality
